meta.title: LeonidaPlay — Play GTA 6 without owning a PS5
meta.description: Rent play time on a real PS5 and play GTA 6 Online in your browser. Own a PS5? Earn money with it while it sits idle.

hero.subtitle: Rent time on a real PS5 and play in your browser — on a basic PC, laptop or phone. Nothing to install. Pay with Pix.
hero.note: Beta spots are limited. Join the list and we'll let you know first.

steps.title: Pick a console
steps.text: See the PS5s available near you. We test your connection before you pay.

steps.title: Top up with Pix
steps.text: Add credits to your wallet in seconds. From R$ 7.50.

steps.title: Play in your browser
steps.text: Use a controller on PC or on-screen buttons on your phone. Your time only starts when the game is on screen.

prices.title: Simple pricing
prices.subtitle: No subscription. Dropped because of the host? We refund the missing minutes automatically.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. You play right in your browser (recent Chrome, Edge or Safari). Works with PlayStation, Xbox or generic controllers on PC, and on-screen buttons on mobile.

items.q: What internet do I need to play?
items.a: We recommend a stable 15 Mbps, ideally wired or 5 GHz Wi‑Fi. Before you pay, we measure latency to the console and show whether your connection is good.

items.q: Does the player get access to my PSN account?
items.a: No. Players use a secondary account on your PS5 with a zero spending limit. They never see your email, password or card, and the buttons that open the system menu are blocked.

items.q: How do I get paid as a host?
items.a: You keep 80% of every session. Sessions are held for 24 h (in case of drops) and paid via Pix every Friday.

items.q: What if the connection drops mid-game?
items.a: If the drop is on the host's side, we automatically refund the missing minutes as wallet credit.
We're in a closed beta in Brazil. People on the waitlist get invited first.
